snippet.title: Galactic Rush Trailer (Windows Phone & Android)
snippet.description:
Be the fastest in the galaxy!
Galactic Rush is an endless runner game for Windows Phone and Android. Beat the challenges, unlock all characters, and compare your score against your friends!

Windows Phone Store:
http://www.windowsphone.com/en-us/store/app/galactic-rush/1bc33e3d-a2c8-4185-94f1-7978dd2a36bf
  
Google Play Store:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.simpleton.galacticrush
